Every January to March, the humpbacks arrive. 🐋

The waters off Nayarit become one of the most spectacular whale watching destinations on earth. Humpback whales migrate here to breed and give birth — and from the boat, the encounters are nothing short of life-changing.

Breaches, tail slaps, mothers and calves — sometimes close enough that you can hear them breathe.

🐋 Humpback whale season: Dec–Mar
🐬 Dolphins year-round
🚤 Small group boat tours from Sayulita & Punta de Mita
📸 Unforgettable photo ops
🌊 Pacific Ocean at its finest

Plan your trip during season and book a tour. You won't regret it.
